build_position_signal: build a tensorflow tensor of fixed sinusoidal position embeddings for a given sequence length
append_position_signal: append position signal embeddings to a batch of word embeddings tensor
create_length_mask: create a boolean mask tensor from a batch of sequence lengths and max length
find_first_occurrence: find the index after the first occurrence of a symbol in each row of a tensor
build_partial_embeddings: build a tensorflow variable with pretrained GloVe embeddings concatenated with trainable random embeddings
